item.title: “It’s Alive!” The launch of Gomer’s new website
item.description: Welcome to Gomer Press’s brand-new website! We’ve been busy refreshing our online presence and want to thank everyone involved in the project. The new website will be regularly updated, so keep an eye on this news section where we’ll discuss print news and industry issues, share exciting themes and trends within book production, and explore ...
